name: How long does a spinal cord injury lawsuit take?
description: The duration varies significantly, from under a year to several years, depending on case complexity, injury severity, and willingness to settle.

mainEntity.name: How long does a spinal cord injury lawsuit take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a spinal cord injury lawsuit varies significantly based on factors such as the complexity of the case, the severity of the injury, the willingness of parties to settle, and court schedules. Simple cases might resolve within a year, while more complex ones, especially those involving extensive future medical care or disputed liability, can take several years to reach a resolution, whether through settlement or trial. Your attorney can provide a more specific timeline after assessing your unique circumstances.
